Steps to link your mobile device with your computer.
Step 1 : Open a browser on your computer.
Step 2 : Go to https://web.zillit.com.
Step 3 : A QR code will appear on the screen.
Step 4 : On your mobile device, click Link Device button and then hold it up to scan the QR code.
Step 5 : You will see a pop up that says device linked successfully.
